pageSubtitle: Comprehensive student care infrastructure including a medically staffed infirmary, extended daycare, and a GPS-monitored bus fleet.

facilities.title: 4-Bed School Infirmary
facilities.description: Dedicated 4-bed infirmary providing immediate first aid and medical supervision under a full-time certified staff nurse.
points: Full-time certified nursing personnel on campus during all working hours
Formal emergency tie-ups with leading multi-specialty hospitals in Mysuru
Annual pediatric dental, vision, and general health checkup camps

facilities.title: Extended Day Care Facility
facilities.description: A safe, nurturing environment for early learners, helping working parents balance professional duties with trusted child care.
points: Supervised nap zones, creative toys, and age-appropriate indoor recreation
Dedicated child caregivers and homework assistance mentors
Hygienic, child-safe environment tailored for early childhood care

facilities.title: GPS-Tracked School Bus Fleet
facilities.description: School-owned fleet serving major residential sectors across Mysuru, equipped with real-time GPS tracking and RTO-mandated speed governors.
points: Dedicated female bus attendant on every bus during morning and evening trips
Real-time GPS tracking enabled for precise stop timing and route monitoring
First-aid kits, emergency fire extinguishers, and speed limiters installed

safetyProtocols.title: CCTV Surveillance
safetyProtocols.desc: 24x7 security monitoring covering gates, hallways, and outdoor grounds.

safetyProtocols.title: Fire Safety Certified
safetyProtocols.desc: Smoke alarms, extinguishers, and periodic student evacuation drills.

safetyProtocols.title: RO Purified Water
safetyProtocols.desc: Multi-stage Reverse Osmosis drinking water dispensers on every floor.

safetyProtocols.title: Child Protection Cell
safetyProtocols.desc: Strict POCSO compliance, visitor badging, and background-verified staff.
